To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the hyperbranched PEI polymers studied in this work have a complex structure, which includes ionic charge, and that the epoxy resin is dominant in determining the relaxation processes in the mixtures.
the hyperbranched polymers are characterized by a complex relaxation behaviour with three dipolar relaxa- tions, the α-relaxation of which is associated with the ionic charge trapped within the PEI.

the HBPEI polymers show a single Tg in DSC, and the DRS of the mixtures with epoxy resin shows that the epoxy resin is the dominant component in the mixtures, while the DMA shows a clear α-relaxation for the mixtures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the interaction between two commercial HBPEIs and DGEBA epoxy resin, and the results are consistent with the formation of an interpenetrating network.
the study of the molecular mobility of HBPEIs of different MW and their interaction with the epoxy resin.
the interaction of HBPEIs with an epoxy resin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HBPEIs are compatible with the epoxy resin, but their mobility is dominated by the epoxy resin.
the molecular mobility of the PEI800 is more affected by the epoxy resin than that of the PEI25000.
the epoxy resin has a strong influence on the dynamics of the HBPEI.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the molecular dynamics of the HBPEI polymers is dominated by the mobility of the terminal groups, and the mobility of the backbone is restricted by the branches.
the HBPEI is a polymer with three different relaxation processes, which are related to the mobility of terminal groups, branches, and ionic charge trapped inside the PEI, respectively.
the HBPEI800 has a higher mobility than the HBPEI25000 and that the epoxy resin mobility is higher than that of the HBPEI.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the molecular weight of the HBPEI does not affect the interaction between the HBPEI and DGEBA, as evidenced by the similar activation energy for the β-relaxation for both HBPEIs.
HBPEI800 and HBPEI25000 behave differently in the mixtures.
the HBPEI800 and PEIs800/DGEBA mixture shows a better thermal stability than PEI25000 and PEI2500/DGEBA mixture.
